newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto-Dominion to redeem C$150 mln debt.
newsitem.headline: Toronto-Dominion to redeem C$150 mln debt.

text.p: Toronto-Dominion Bank said on Thursday it plans to call for redemption of its outstanding C$150 million 8.75 percent debentures due December 30, 2001.
The debentures will be due and payable on December 30, 1996, at a price of 100 percent of the principal amount. The debentures were originally issued in December 1991.

"The 8.75 percent debentures represent very expensive tier II capital by today's standards. Redemption of the debentures is cost-effective and will have no effect on the bank's strong common equity-capital ratio," Vice-Chairman Robert Kelly said in a statement.
